activity.title: Activity

admin.brandLead: White-label brand. Change name, logos and colors without touching issuer integration.
admin.feeTemplatesDesc: Create HQ default and extra policies. Partners without a selection follow HQ. Partner-level edits take priority.
admin.kitSave: Save MID, API Key, Secret, and HMAC now. These are ICOCARD keys, not Wirex.
admin.ourKeysNotWirex: Use ICOCARD keys issued by HQ only. Never use Wirex keys.
admin.deliveryHint: API integration or a sub-solution package at /s/{slug}. All keys are issued by HQ.
admin.deliveryStandaloneHint: The merchant operates with their own Wirex contract keys. ICOCARD does not issue reseller keys.
admin.walletFollowHqHint: Uses the HQ default wallet modes.
admin.walletHqHint: Merchants set to Follow HQ use these modes. Disabled modes are blocked in the member app and Partner API.
admin.isolationHqHint: Wirex sees ICOCARD only. Partners never receive Wirex keys.
admin.customersDesc: Individuals who use the card. Each customer is a single account. Reset password and OTP here.
admin.settingsFeeHint: Set the treasury wallet here. Create HQ fee policies under Merchant → Fee policy, then choose Follow HQ or Custom when registering a merchant.

partner.ourKeysNotWirex: Authenticate with HQ-issued MID / API Key / Secret. Do not use Wirex keys.
partner.apiHint: Call card and wallet APIs from your merchant site using headers.
partner.manual1: HQ registers the merchant and issues MID, API Key, and Secret.
partner.manual2: HQ creates a partner user under User accounts.
partner.manual3: Review API, fees, and this manual in the portal.
partner.manual4: Issue cards on your site with X-API-Key and X-Partner-User-Id.
partner.manual5: Wallets: embedded, external EOA connect, or bridge. Card spend uses our Smart Wallet only.
partner.manual6: A sub-solution is the member app at /s/{slug}. Keys are issued by HQ, never Wirex.
partner.standaloneHint: Standalone: operations only. No ICOCARD Partner API keys. Tenant Wirex keys are stored encrypted by HQ.
partner.noReseller: Standalone disables the reseller API. Operate via the member app only.
partner.manual7: Standalone sub-solution uses the merchant Wirex contract for operations only. No reseller keys. Wirex sees that merchant.
partner.staffHint: Partners can add staff to operate the dashboard. This is not a card customer.
partner.staffNoAdd: Only an admin can add users.

walletMode.title: Wallet connection
walletMode.lead: Card spend always leaves our Smart Wallet (WUSD/WEUR). A connected wallet is for signing and identity only.
walletMode.spendNote: POS never prompts MetaMask. BTC, Solana, and closed-loop points use the bridge into our rail.
walletMode.embeddedDesc: We issue and store the EOA plus Wirex Smart Wallet.
walletMode.externalDesc: Bind a MetaMask (or other EVM) wallet by signature. Card balance stays on our Smart Wallet.
walletMode.needMetamask: A browser wallet such as MetaMask is required.
walletMode.bridgeDesc: Non-connectable assets are debited on the partner ledger and credited to our Smart Wallet.
walletMode.noneEnabled: No wallet mode is enabled for this merchant. Contact HQ.

customer.title: Customer guide
customer.lead: For individual card users. Same text on the HQ app and every partner type.
customer.c1Body: Register with email and password. If OTP is on, enter the authenticator code. Sub-solutions use the same flow at /s/{slug}.
customer.c2Body: Embedded (we issue the wallet), external EOA (MetaMask bind), or bridge (BTC/points ledger). Only modes allowed for the merchant appear. Card spend uses our Smart Wallet only.
customer.c3Body: Issue a virtual card in the app. Plastic is available when the merchant policy allows it. KYC may be required.
customer.c4Body: Top up with an allowed wallet mode, then pay. See Activity for history.
customer.c5Body: Manage password and OTP in Account. HQ or partner operators can reset them if needed.
customer.c6Body: Use the brand support on this screen. Do not contact Wirex directly.

api.title: API integration guide
api.lead: Call from your app with HQ-issued MID, API Key, and Secret. You never receive Wirex keys.
api.a1Body: Shown once at merchant registration. Use X-API-Key, X-API-Secret, X-ICO-Mid, and optional HMAC.
api.a2Body: Identify end users with X-Partner-User-Id. Wirex sees ICOCARD only.
api.a3Body: Call /api/partner/v1/cards, /wallet, /bridge. Disabled wallet modes are rejected.
api.a4Body: Partners cannot see Wirex. Wirex cannot see sub-merchants.
api.a5Body: Give end users the customer guide below.

sub.title: Sub-solution operations
sub.lead: Operate the branded member app at /s/{slug}. Keys are ICOCARD HQ keys.
sub.s1Body: Logo and name are branded. Customers use the same sign-up and card flow as HQ.
sub.s2Body: Use only the HQ kit. Wirex keys are not distributed.
sub.s3Body: Add operators in the partner portal. They are not card customers.
sub.s4Body: Show members the customer guide as-is.

standalone.title: Standalone operations
standalone.lead: Operate with the merchant Wirex contract. No ICOCARD reseller keys.
standalone.t1Body: Run the card service on the member app. No Partner API resale or key redistribution.
standalone.t2Body: Wirex sees this merchant. HQ keys are never used as fallback.
standalone.t3Body: Add operators in the partner portal.
standalone.t4Body: Show members the customer guide as-is.
